108000.description:
16-year-old Yukito Kirihara lives with his 14-year-old sister Sana, who he treasures more than anyone else. But when an ogre shows up outside of his window looking for Sana (a shocking event in its own right), Yukito leaps to save her—and is killed. He's offered the promise of reincarnation by a mysterious woman, who gives him a character sheet in a mysterious book. But when Yukito sees Sana in there, too, he sets off to find her, and save them both—even if he only has 1 hp with which to do it!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Another World Munchkin: Conquering the Dungeon as the Strongest and the Fastest with Only 1 HP
สุดเห่ยเกิดใหม่ต่างโลก HP แค่ 1 แต่สุดแกร่งสุดเปรียวพิชิตดันเจี้ยน

title.english: Otherworldly Munchkin: Let’s Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP!
title.native: 異世界マンチキン　ーＨＰ１のままで最強最速ダンジョン攻略ー
title.romaji: Isekai Munchkin: HP 1 no Mama de Saikyou Saisoku Dungeon Kouryaku

title.native: 琴ノ葉さんが恋してる

108002.description:
The manga's story centers on Suzuo Takahata, an unpopular manga artist who spends his days drinking and gambling until one day, he dies from an accident. In a place in the afterlife where people are assigned to their next lives, he manages to be reincarnated as a cat, and is able to return to his family for a limited time.

(Source: Anime News Network)

108003.description: An underground-dweller named Chi-chan wanted to come to the human world in search for sweets. After he finished his objective and he wanted to come back to his home, he would be stuck on the hole where he came from. He would then be saved by a girl named Yuka Saeki, who dug the hole where Chi-chan was stuck back there, and would then took care of Chi-chan in her home.

108004.description:
Taking place during the events of Millionaires' Conspiracy, the series follows Katrielle Layton, daughter of the renowned Professor Hershel Layton, who has set up the Layton Detective Agency alongside her self-appointed assistant, Ernest Greeves, and a talking dog she dubs Sherl. Together, they take on all kinds of requests to solve mysterious cases troubling their fellow Britons.

(Source: Wikipedia)
synonyms: Layton Mystery Detective Agency: Kat's Mystery-Solving Files

title.romaji: Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katori no Nazotoki File

title.romaji: Sensei ga Konna ni Do Hentai nan datte Koto wo Touzen Minna wa Shiranai

108006.description: This is a fluffy romantic comedy about a dull and quiet guy, and a very ordinary girl.

She Looks Especially Cute to Me

title.native: 特別に可愛く見えるのです。
title.romaji: Tokubetsu ni Kawaiku Mieru no desu.

108007.description:
Little girls that look like little animals – Kon-chan, as well as her friends Baru-chan and Yume-chan. They live in the care of a human father in order to grow up, and have a very fun and exciting daily life.

A wonderful, cute, soft and fluffy story.

108008.description:
'Creepy Side', is a creepy and eerie neighborhood. A series of tragedies mixed with black comedy in this town begins!

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

title.native: タイガーデッドライン

108011.description:
After a long journey, Noa finds the "Class Change Book." He's done to all to abandon his bothersome "Hero" role and gain a new class... "Monster Tamer."

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: The Sole Monster Tamer in the World: I was Mistaken as the Demon King When I Changed My Job

title.romaji: Sekai de Tadahitori no Mamono Tsukai: Tenshoku Shitara Maou ni Machigawaremashita

108012.description:
When the babies in your womb are abnormally developed twin fetuses, that's not kicking you're feeling.

Published in Shounen Ai no Bigaku 12

108013.description:
In the year 20××, the government experimentally revived the exile system in response to the ever-increasing number of violent criminals. Sixty-two criminals whose crimes were considered worthy of the death penalty were instead sent to an island known as "Lawless Island"...

A young man arrives on this island after his family was brutally murdered and he was falsely accused of the crime. Faced with a situation far more horrifying than he could have imagined, the story begins to unfold...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

108014.description: Published in Shounen Ai no Bigaku EX 1

108015.description: Published in Shounen Ai no Bigaku 8: The Bokura no Natsuyasumi

108016.description:
A teacher goes to great lengths to hide his baldness.

Published in Shounen Ai no Bigaku 7

108017.description:
Last year, a family moved in next door to Mayu and she grew to like them, but then things escalated and she ended up becoming a stalker. One day, when she gazed at their house from her room, she noticed that the wife wasn't around. Mayu found this strange, so she began to investigate her whereabouts, but...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: ファミリーストーカー

Tatoeba, Sora ni Kujira ga Tonde.

108022.description: Akiko always tries so hard to please her boyfriends, but it only scared them away. After getting dumped once again, she has no home, no job, and no boyfriend. Thankfully, all the household skills she learned should come in handy as she applies to be the concierge of a luxury apartment complex with a handsome but mysterious owner.

title.native: シンデレラ・コンシェルジュ

108024.description:
By means of an unforeseen accident, a peerlessly beautiful young male model loses his beauty. To raise him up out of the depths of despair...
Oneshot from Tenraku Danshi comic anthology.

synonyms: The Prayer of John James Audubon

108027.description:
Basketball players. Bad boys who aren’t really bad boys. Roommates. Senpai-kouhai BL romance. It all started when Kagiura moved into the school dorms with what seemed to be a bad-boy upperclassman. But after he’s left in the tender care of his mother hen of a roommate, Hirano, it’s too much to ask for Kagiura not to fall in love…right?!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: ฮิราโนะกับคางิอุระ

108028.description: Shiori is turning 35, married for 9 years and trying to adapt to the unvarying and boring routine as a wife. She thought that this tranquillity will be their future as a married couple but one she stumbles on a diary on her husband's study. As Shiori reads through the pages, she realizes it is her husband's diary where he put down in writing all his private moments with his lover! Is it time for Shiori to start her own diary?

108030.description:
Lunaria, a girl who has been cursed to become a white snake, is deposited at a house to remove the curse. However, in order for Lunaria to live as a human, she must kiss once per day.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 白蛇嬢にキスください。

108033.description:
A beautifully illustrated shoujo manga tale of medicine, royal intrigue, and romance in a setting inspired by historical China!

Whether it be for illness or injury, the preferred healing method in Moon Flower Kingdom has always been the country’s special medicinal baths. However, after his party is attacked by a mysterious figure during a regional inspection, Prince Keiun witnesses a never-before-seen lifesaving medical technique. Even more shocking still, the one who performed this feat is a young girl named Koyo! And while luck may have been on their side this time, questions remain. Just who is this girl, and who is after the prince’s life? Shadowy conspiracies, mysterious religions, and deep-rooted beliefs all collide in this beautifully drawn manga series!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Remède Impérial - L'étrange médecin de la cour
Koyo – Die exzentrische Ärztin des Mondblumenreichs

title.english: The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom

108034.description: This "turn-of-the-century mystery manga" takes place in a Japan where an unknown infectious disease has killed off more than half the country's population. The interests of two men - Ruslan the coroner and Sanajima the police officer - align as they work together to solve the mysteries of their dystopian world.

108036.description:
20 years ago, Sawada Masatoshi fired a rocket launcher into a rival yakuza's headquarters, earning him the nickname "Rocket Masa" and cementing his reputation as a notorious outlaw. Now, the infamous Rocket Masa is back, wreaking havoc on the streets of Kokura, Kyushu!

(Source: Emaqi)

108044.description: Hanako and Shiori have been best friends since childhood. Everyone who looks at them think they are the perfect duo, a "prince" and "princess" meant for each other. This story travels through various stages of their lives, guided by the question: what is the true nature of our relationship?

title.native: 月と恋は満ちれば欠ける。
title.romaji: Tsuki to Koi wa Michireba Kakeru

108045.description: In the fictional Italian city of St. Aria, a reporter gets caught up in a power struggle between gang members who use a drug called "Fantasies" to gain the abilities of mythical creatures.

108046.description: This is a comedy love story about a master and her disciple.

title.native: 弟子が可愛すぎてつらい

108047.description: On the day Tatsuya greets his twentieth birthday alone, he meets a black cat. He feeds it on a whim and is surprised when it suddenly speaks! Before he knew it, the delinquent-like Tatsuya is transformed into a different person; someone with a pretty face! With a body now capable of forcing a man into heat, he is suddenly attacked by a stranger! Whilst under the spell of the rampaging heat of his body, he is found by his childhood friend Kentarou, who came to celebrate his birthday with him. This body makes a man go into heat... the only way to reverse the spell is with a creampie!

title.native: ドーテーヤンキーマギクス✡

108048.description:
Blum Dilmond killed the demon king and became a hero, and for some reason, he was pursued by the Kingdom and tried to escape.

While spending days trying to avoid the assassins aiming at his neck, he suddenly came up with an idea. The dungeon which is the home of the Demon King​. If it’s there, then he could be safe.

Blum didn’t hesitate and went into the dungeon, but he met an unexpected person. In the deepest part of the dungeon, there was the appearance of a mage who helped him fight the demon. Moreover, the subordinate of the Demon King that served as a maid is also there. The name of that maid is Irene.

Since their interest match, they agreed to both cooperate with each other. The demon king is dead and they will personally rebuild the worn out dungeon, they began to work earnestly in order to make a safe haven.

title.native: ダンジョン暮らしの元勇者

108049.description:
Blum Dilmond killed the demon king and became a hero, and for some reason, he was pursued by the Kingdom and tried to escape.

While spending days trying to avoid the assassins aiming at his neck, he suddenly came up with an idea. The dungeon which is the home of the Demon King​. If it’s there, then he could be safe.

Blum didn’t hesitate and went into the dungeon, but he met an unexpected person. In the deepest part of the dungeon, there was the appearance of a mage who helped him fight the demon. Moreover, the subordinate of the Demon King that served as a maid is also there. The name of that maid is Irene.

Since their interest match, they agreed to both cooperate with each other. The demon king is dead and they will personally rebuild the worn out dungeon, they began to work earnestly in order to make a safe haven.

title.romaji: Dungeon Kurashi no Moto Yuusha THE COMIC

108050.description: A story of a villain, Fang Yuan who was reborn 500 years into the past with the  Spring Autumn Cicada he painstakingly refined. With his profound wisdom, battle and life experiences, he seeks to overcome his foes with skill and wit! Ruthless and amoral, he has no need to hold back as he pursues his ultimate goals. In a world of cruelty where one cultivates using Gu - magical creatures of the world - Fang Yuan must rise up above all with his own power.

108051.description:
The fun-filled life of a girl and her cat, who can communicate with humans.

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

108052.description:
Runako is studying hard to someday succeed as owner of her family's maid dispatching service company. One day, a request comes in from an entertainment production company and shockingly, it's for their super-popular star, Seirei Moroboshi! But could it be that the image he projects on the TV is far different than his true secret face...?!

(Source: Vice Comic)
synonyms: Lovely Housemaid and Her Arrogant Master.

108059.description: Note: Published in COMIC Mate legend Vol.3 2015-06

108061.description:
In the year 2030, the Beilan Island Incident causes global land contamination and severely reduces the world population. In response to shortages in manpower, humanity creates Autonomous Dolls: highly advanced androids with superior strength and advanced AI capable of expressing emotions. Furthermore, during World War 3 (2045 to 2051), PMCs (private military companies) develop Tactical Dolls: Autonomous Dolls with the ability to fight. Acquiring great wealth from the war, these companies become the de facto police and military of many nations.

During this era of waning government power, Tactical Dolls of Sangvis Ferri (the world's largest PMC) suddenly kill their human masters and attack nearby human settlements. In response, Grifon & Kryuger PMC and their Tactical Dolls are hired to stop and contain the Sangvis Ferri forces.
synonyms: ドールズフロントライン 人形之歌

title.native: 少女前线 - 人形之歌

108063.description:
High schooler Kensuke Fuji adores cats, but in a family full of people who are allergic, he's never been able to spend much time with the furry felines. When he meets the Ultimate Cat Whisperer, Kensuke finds a kindred spirit who seems to understand everything about cats! Deciding to become a disciple of this “kitty bonkers” cat-guru, Kensuke is on his way to learning the secrets of the Cat Fist Way, as a doorway into the secret world of cats opens up!

(Source: Dark Horse)

108065.description:
1. Tanoshii Choukyou Nyuumon (たのしい調教入門); Comic Tenma 2015-04
2-4. Yuuwaku (誘惑); Comic Tenma 2015-01, 02, 03
5. Uchi no Imouto ga Wari to Kawaii. (ウチの妹が割と可愛い。, My Little Sister Is Relatively Cute); Comic Tenma 2014-12

9-11. Hamedolita (ハメ撮リータ); Comic Tenma 2014-01, 02, 03

108066.description:
After more than 2,000 years, Nomi no Sukune's successor is born. This time, Baki will challenge the God of Sumo.

Note: The chapter count includes an extra chapter.

108067.description:
A collection of stories featuring young adults navigating the workforce and trying to understand romantic relations as their lives are intertwine in unexpected ways.

1. It's nice to be young. [Originally published in the magazine as Dare Datte Skylark (誰だってスカイラーク)].
Kishi works in the anime industry but doesn't really like his job. During one of his regular disappearances, he runs into a rather mischievous cat who follows him home and begins stalking him wherever he goes!

2. Mahou ga Tsukaenakutemo (魔法が使えなくても)

3. Paradise! (パラダイス!)
Mayu and Kiki are two middle school girls from Hokkaido who came to Harajuku as part of their school trip. Kiki ends up going to an Idol concert with her otaku friend Mayu. Will the happy-go-lucky Mayu and the left out Kiki be able to take a picture with her idol?

4. Suginami ku Nite (すぎなみくにて)
Kishi, who had no hopes or dreams, suddenly quit his job at an anime company. Chiyo, the girl he was interested in, worked there.

5. Sweet Side A
6. Sweet Side B
7. Sweet Side C
synonyms: 誰だってスカイラーク
Dù cho không có phép màu

108068.description:
A woman bad with kids, and a boy bad with people, find themselves living together after losing their "Beloved". Living out in the boonies in a snow-covered village, they only have each other to hold on to in their comisery, despite the friction between them. And when the boy, Fuusuke, asks Suzuka for "Blood"...

(Source: HaruPARTY)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

108069.description: Class president and overall good girl Koguma is concerned that her classmate Hino often skips classes by spending her time behind one of the school buildings. Koguma feels it's her duty to guide Hino down a better path, even if it means going along with Hino's unusual requests.

108070.description:
Tanaka Iori is a worker for a company that sets unreasonable demands, on top of that she has a penchant for dating married men. What a recipe for disaster! One day she gets drunk with an acquaintance and wakes up the next morning by her side naked! What's Iori to do?

Notes:
- Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
- Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

108071.description:
Collection of stories:

1) Tomodachi no Uta - First Part (2013)
2) Tomodachi no Uta - Last Part (2013)
3) Tomodachi Enja

108072.description: Akane is a nice and cheerful girl whose dream has always been to become a singer and reach many people with her voice. To achieve it, she even gave up on having a normal and fun time with her high school friends... until one day she meets a girl, Fumi, and by befriending her undergoes major changes in her life. This is the story of their friendship and their shared love for music.

108073.description:
King Kid protects his town from the evil mayor, Cinnamon. But what will happen when God gets sick?

Honorable mention in the 14th Jump Treasure Newcomer Manga Prize.

108074.description: A sombre look into the life of a young woman with a dark past and a creepy housemate.

108075.description:
Ryunosuke loves baseball, thanks to the encouragement his mom gave him before she passed away. On the day Ryunosuke is set to turn in his permission slip for the third grade baseball team, his father tells him about his new adopted sister, Koharu Mori. Koharu is blind with prosthetic arms and legs.

Ryunosuke's father insists that since he can't be at home regularly, Ryunosuke must stop going to school in order to take care of Koharu. Ryunosuke hates giving up on his dream, resenting his new sister, but warms up to her after she saves him from a monster. When that monster reappears, his dad reveals the truth: his sister has an inhuman power that can destroy the world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes the one-shot "The Tales of Momo: Toshiharu and Friends".

108076.description: In a world where humanity has declined, Chico travels with her brother Pinot.

108077.description:
A "boyfriend" is "sent" to the smartphone of a heartbroken girl.

(Source: Anime News Network)

108078.description:
Tells the story about the women's air force units from Soviet Union in World War II.

Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

108081.description:
An unusual manga depicting a bar where octopuses are bartending at the bottom of the ocean.

(Source: natalie, translated)

title.native: しょうもないのうりょく

108083.description:
Takahashi only ever wears plain clothes. Watanabe wears stylish and fashionable clothes. Suzuki has a complex that only lets her wear conservative clothes. Tanaka is a gal who arms herself with cute clothes. Despite working at the same company, each of these women has a different appearance and values. Suzume Takano's Atarashii Hifu follows four women and the stories that revolve around the way they dress.

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

108084.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Sayonara Girlfriend
2. Omokage Sunset
3. Watashi no New Town
4. Galaxy Kaikou
5. Maboroshi Cyanosis
6. Alien/Summer

108086.description: An omnibus stories about the ​daily lives of residents of "Colder Heights" apartment, and their various fetishes.

108087.description:
The story follows a canceled manga artist and a blond girl.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Oretachi no Nichijou wa Hajimatta Bakari Da

title.romaji: Oretachi no Nichijou wa Hajimatta Bakari da

108089.description:
Elizabeth was known as a villainess but in fact, she was a decent and honest girl. But she was accused by mistake, found guilty and exiled...but she accepted her situation. That was because...she had her memory from her previous life as an event planner in Japan, and she knew what was coming. She was in the Otome game world she loved!! She started enjoying her life as an apprentice to sisters at Church of Nortia which is located in a rural village. And she doesn't have to follow the story from here!! Now Elizabeth can using her skill from her previous life, to make her life easier. No one's noticing, so this will be OK, right? But then, the knight commander moves close and tells her he's watching. What does he want?

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: The Banished Villainess! Living the Leisurely Life of a Nun Making Revolutionary Church Food
Akuyaku Reijou no Tsuihougo! Kyoukai Kaikaku Gohan de Yuuyuu Shisutaa Kurashii

title.native: 悪役令嬢の追放後！ 教会改革ごはんで悠々シスター暮らし
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Tsuihougo! Kyoukai Kaikaku Gohan de Yuuyuu Sister Kurashii

108090.description:
On her first day at her new school, Hanako Ochanomizu meets Saiichiro Kanda, a classmate and hairpin craftsman with godlike feminine charm. She falls in love with Kanda's godlike manner, and before she can confess her feelings, she ends up becoming his apprentice!

A comedy filled with male craftsmen, including a Japanese umbrella maker, a hanten maker, and a Japanese confectionery maker!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 職人男子 神田くん

108091.description:
Astronomy and geology are fun…!
Mira, who promised to “find an asteroid” with the boy she found at the campsite as a child.
She tried to join the astronomy club, but from this year the “astronomy club” and the “geology research society” merged into the “earth sciences club”!?
Let’s go search for the asteroid that we promised to look for that day.

(Source: Manga Time Kirara Carat, translated)
synonyms: 恋する小惑星〈アストロイド〉

108093.description:
It’s Monday, February 15th, in the quiet neighbourhood of Asahigaoka, the day after Valentine’s Day. The two angels Spinet and Vivace are a little exhausted from their work the previous day but still they manage to watch over the love lives of a handful of girls and young women who are all connected to some degree on that fateful snowy night of candles lit and stories told during an electricity blackout in the small residential area.

(Source: coinlockerbaby)

Includes the one shot Karuku Kasukanaru Oto nite (かるくかすかなる音にて).
synonyms: Tenshi mo Yume Miru Rosoku Yoru
かるくかすかなる音にて

title.native: 童年破壊～狼と七匹の子羊～
title.romaji: Dounen Hakai: Ookami to Nanahiki no Kohitsuji

108095.description:
The society calls the teaching of Yuhun Sect as “Heresy," which relying on the technique to tame spiritual beasts using magic tools. For Mo Lianjian, a young disciple who lost his parents since a little, expertise on the practice is a struggle especially when his genius childhood friend, Lian Beibei always tries to pick a fight. One day, Mo obtained a fragment of a legendary sword which rumored to be owned by the last swordsman of Yuhun Sect...

(Source: manga.club)

108096.description:
Mikura, Natsuki's best friend, wants to "shed his angel wings" and lose his damned virginity already, but like hell is Natsuki ever gonna let that happen! Under the guise of dressing up as Mikura's "practice girlfriend," Natsuki plots to distract him long enough until he never looks for a real girlfriend - but how far is he willing to go under the excuse of "practice"?

(Source: Futekiya)
synonyms: A Happy Ending Is Not Acceptable
Endless Love Call From The Lips

108097.description:
Protecting your turf, keeping other guys from pawing at your girl, showing everyone who's boss...it's all in a day's work when you're a street thug-er, a street cat!

(Source: Yen Press)

108098.description:
Everything fell apart after the miscarriage of Nori's sister. Her husband left her and she was reduced to a depressed shut-in. One day she suddenly brought home a cute little girl called Yumi-chan, who was supposed to be her friend's kid. Nori's sister soon regained her smile, but Nori felt something was off with Yumi-chan, and the rest of her family.

(Source: Manga Rock)

108099.description:
Ji Hyunwoo gets a chance to turn his life around after signing a contract with a rich and powerful woman! But why does it feel like everyone wants a piece of me...?!

(Source: Toomics)

(Note: Chapter count includes a prologue)

108100.description:
Kasumi city. A city where young people are, just like public companies, listed on a market called RELEASE and have a market value. Their future prospects decide their value; Those with great academic and athletic skills have a higher market value. They're also given a platform to advertise themselves on. One day, in that same city a certain incident occurs. A mysterious app is installed on people's devices, and the whole city turns into a battlefield. A battle to defeat others and steal market their value has begun. Yuusuke who suddenly gets involved in this whole deadly game of tag is rescued in the nick of time by his classmate and the girl he just started dating - Marie. The girl who's usually all alone and rebels against the system that is RELEASE. But who is she really and what is this death game?

The birth of an anti-heroine and a school fantasy never before seen.

108101.description:
At seven years old, Zen's parents, sister, and his own left leg were swallowed by the mysterious gloved entity only known as Shake Hand. And Zen's not the only one—in the seven years after, these "gloved hand" incidents have only increased, and others have lost families and limbs, too. But Zen is powerless to do anything about it...until the fateful night his eyes are opened and he once again comes face to face with the mysterious, murderous Shake Hand—and the artisan syndicate sworn to stop him, known as Bootsleg!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

108102.description:

108115.description:
This fantasy story conveys the bond between a beast tamer and the strongest cat girl starting from their first meeting! Rein, a beast tamer who fights with the help of animals, has been a member of the hero's party for the longest time. However, unbeknownst to him, he was dragging down his teammates because he had no other abilities. "You have no worth outside of taming animals. You're fired." With that, he was kicked out of the party. At that moment, Rein no longer wanted anything to do with saving the world and decided to live for himself. Once he set out to become an adventurer, he met a girl from the cat tribe, a tribe believed to be part of the superior race. Meanwhile, the hero's party was unaware they were only able to fight the Demon King's army all along because of Rein's power... This story is about how the oppressed beast tamer met his destined comrades and formed bonds with them all.

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: The Beast Tamer Exiled from the the Hero's Party and the Cat Eared Girl from the Strongest Race Meet

108116.description:
After being summoned into another world, the Goddess of Mercy wishes for him to be a hero. But can he really be the hero of Erostica...?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

108117.description: After their mother’s death, two brothers resolve to take revenge on their abusive father. Young Danny, sunk in grief, dreams of escape, and with the support of his older brother Eddy, he devises a daring plan that might finally bring him freedom. But time is running out: winter draws near, and if they are to succeed, they must act swiftly—and with absolute discretion.

108118.description: The story follows Allen Avadonia after the annihilation of the Millennium Tree Forest by "Punishment", sent on a journey to meet the souls of individuals involved with the vessels of sin by Sickle.

title.native: 恋の罪 -エルネスティナ-

108120.description:
Jihoon is the last person to be seen with a girl. He's spent his entire life turning down girls because his heart simply does not skip a beat for any girl. And then there's Sol, whose heart beats for every man out there. Serendipitously, the two meet at their college orientation, and whereas Jihoon finds himself helplessly in love, Sol finds herself able to breath in the presence of a man for the first time ever. Jihoon needs to win her heart, but he can't even speak to her without blushing or stuttering. Luckily for Jihoon, his friends come up with a devious plan to bring Sol and Jihoon together. Will the plan work?

(Source: Lezhin)

108122.description: Wakagi Hokuto is a mahjong player who has an extraordinary amount of luck, to the point where he can get tenhou once a week. With this power, he aims to become like the North Star, an unmovable giant of a man.

title.native: モトヤマチーフの秘密

108126.description:
One day, Mizuki gets rejected by school prince and student body president Seima Takajo. While sobbing his eyes out behind the school, he meets Fuji, a fierce-looking upperclassman who wears a surgical mask. The older boy is awkward, yet kind as he desperately tries to comfort Mizuki. "I want to tell Seima how I feel, so help me!" Mizuki says, demanding Fuji's cooperation. Despite his appearance, Fuji's actually pretty soft, and he even thinks the sharp-tongued, mischievous Mizuki is cute. At some point, Mizuki starts losing track of his goals... Fierce, weak, and sickly, can a prince with a triple handicap find happiness with a mischievous "princess" of a boy!?

(Source: Renta!)

108127.description:
Itsumi Tachibana hates fighting. He's a student at a fancy high school who loves visiting cat cafes and collecting kitty-themed merchandise. Despite that, he looks like a gangster, which alienates him from his classmates, making him a magnet for unsavory characters outside of school. One day, the unthinkable happens: the popular, brilliant, and beautiful student body president, Seima Takajou, professes his love for Itsumi! This is a romance between complete opposites: a popular hot guy and his scary-but-sweet Cinderella!

(Source: Renta!)

108129.description: Games are now more immersive than they have ever been since fully diving into a game is perfectly possible! But what would you do… If you get spawned as a NPC Blacksmith? SuFei begins his everyday bitter and dull Blacksmith life together with a beautiful female player and his Loli assistant. However, everything ended in that NPC trip….. Don’t come over, I’m really a NPC! Wait, what the heck is your slogan? “ Exterminate the players, the world belongs to the NPCs?"

title.romaji: Wo Shi Ge Jia De NPC

108132.description: Sakura, who continues to live alone even after reaching the age of 30, decides to marry in order to reassure his parents. But the truth is… he’s an otomen who likes cute stuff and is a closet gay man. Keeping these circumstances hidden, he goes to a marriage counselor and reunites with his younger childhood friend Yuusuke by chance.

title.native: きっと王子様がなんて
どうかラブだと言ってくれ!

108137.description:
People called “boxers” manipulate rare mysterious bags from which rare items and artworks from around the world can be pulled out. The town where they lived close together was called the “boxer town”. There is a man who uses his powers to rescue "boxers", who are being used by villainous people all over the world, and delivers them to the "boxer town".

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

108138.description:
Serialization of comedian Shuuichi Takizawa's autobiographical story about his daily life working as a garbage collector.

Originally published on Twitter.

title.native: 犬と魔法のファンタジー

108141.description:
One night, right after he was dumped by his boyfriend, a pair of underwear came falling down upon Ise’s head. The one who dropped it was a man named Hishimoto, who Ise couldn’t seem to ignore, and they end up working together to bring in the laundry that had fallen onto a tree outside his window.

After being told by Hishimoto that he would like to thank him, Ise goes up to his place. There, he is told that Hishimoto has been thinking about him, and had used the fallen laundry as an excuse. Further more, Hishimoto then flirts with him, asking if he’s interested in older men…?!

synonyms: Amadeus the Hero Against False Gods

title.native: 偽神英雄のアマデウス

108143.description: Other people shut themselves in to cultivate while I run my business and strike a deal. People mock my metallic odour, but watching their pride and honour fall as they kneel down trying to haggle is my happiness. My road to success will come using gold, silver, and jade!

synonyms: A time in the limelight for this fool too!

108150.description:
A collection of BL stories that take place in a world with six genders.

Xiaomi, an omega, has been in love with the popular Jiang Xi, an alpha, since middle school... Even though they both changed over the years as they graduated and started living different lives, Xiaomi's feelings have not changed. It is painful to experience an unrequited love for 10 years, is it not? But what will happen when Xiaomi brings an intoxicated Jiang Xi home to his bed after their university's graduation party, knowing that Jiang Xi will soon be going abroad?

108151.description:
Kasumi, a high school graduate who entered a dark-side company 3 years ago was in the midst of a late night overtime for the 30th day in a row when she wished that she could have "a single day off" to the shooting star she was watching on the roof when suddenly she was swallowed by a mysterious light...... The next thing she knew, she was standing, waiting to be introduced to her new colleagues at "White Products"! Will Kasumi be able to get used to the culture of the light side of the business after thinking that the dark side's dealings are "normal"?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

108152.description:
A modern-day engineer is transmigrated to a different world... where he becomes a prince.
His surroundings remind him of medieval Europe, but it's not quite the same.
In this world, witches actually exist, and they have real magic powers! Magic powers... that can be used as a productive force!
The witches must be saved. Their powers must be liberated!
We must open our map, fight off demons, solve the conspiracy, and climb the tree of technology!

(Source: Webnovel)

108153.description: When Momoka's mother and Touri's father married, the two kids became sister and brother overnight, but as they grew up together, this relationship began to change...

108154.description:
A mermaid falls in love with prince Lewen while trying to feed on his heart. She decides to spare him and to die herself. Cursed by another mermaid, the mysterious beauty winds up at Lewen's palace as a human. Unable to speak and express her love for him, she is taken in and renamed Merin by Lewen, who doesn't recognize her. Meanwhile, Lewen's older brother Lewinel, brings home his prospective queen, princess Irena of Ladivita, to restore his impoverished kingdom, Erenbur. But Lewinel, kind and well-mannered, doesn't realize that Lewen is planning malicious intrigues that could destroy everybody's future...

(Source: NETCOMICS)

108155.description: A story that reveals how a pre-6th Gen Head Tesshou Kawachi first encounters and then joins The Front of Armament, and also meets characters like Shougo Murata.

108156.description:
Two childhood friends are in love with the same boy.

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.
synonyms: You and I fell in love with the same person
10th: Zakochaliśmy się w tej samej osobie

108158.description:
A young man takes on female roles in Japan's early film industry.

(Source: diaCLB)

title.native: めもくらむ 大正キネマ浪漫

108159.description:
Nakki becomes a passionate teacher at the school she once went to herself, then goes to study in Finland & comes back to found her own school to save the future of her hometown.

(Source: diaCLB)

title.native: 生徒諸君！ 最終章・旅立ち

108160.description:
Kise is a young girl in her 2nd year of secondary school who lives in a seaside town and no longer wants to go to school.

One day, as she tries to save a stranded whale with the help of a friend, she finds herself revealing her secret which links her to the mermaid Lorelei, whose singing can make you lose consciousness.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

108161.description:
Nao Kazushiro is a normal high school student—until he gets in a traffic accident and winds up in the body of a cat! At first, it’s all fun and games as he gets used to his new form, but then the novelty wears off and the hunger sets in. Luckily, he’s picked up by Chika, a girl his age, who gives him food and a home off the streets. She’s paw-fully sweet and pretty, but meanwhile he’s still in a furry feline body! Will Nao (now Nyao) ever get his human form back, or will fur end up flying instead of sparks?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: My New Life as a Cat
title.native: ねこ、はじめました～ニャンとも気になるニャオ～

108162.description:
Tall and boyish Hwanhee is a schoolgirl like any other, with a crush on the volleyball team captain. But with the sudden confession from a childhood friend, her life spirals into the extraordinary – Hwanhee’s the descendant of powerful vampires and next in line to become the queen of vampire society!

(Source: TappyToon)

Note: chapter count contains a prologue

108163.description:
Hayami is the it-woman at her job—she's cool, confident, and admired by all. But her has-it-all exterior belies a dark secret...her house is a mess, and she's no good at taking care of herself! Enter Yamamoto-kun—her colleague who thinks the world of her, and who refuses to let her slobbish behavior slide. Soon he's over at her house often enough that she asks him to move in with her! Where will this roundabout relationship take them?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Notes:
- Originally a one-shot published in Kiss Magazine 2018 June issue, it was picked up for full serialization starting in the 2019 April issue.
- Includes three extras chapters.

108164.description:
From the first day I got forced to a girl and caught in marriage, In the tenth day or so, the country begins to glare at me and my life will not go well.

I will continue to live without losing to such a difficulties (?).
synonyms: A 29-Years-Old Bachelor Was... Brought to a Different World to Live Freely... At Least He Wanted To.
A 29 Years Old Guy Living Single, Transported to a New World to Live Freely... At Least He Wanted To

title.native: 29歳独身は異世界で自由に生きた……かった。
title.romaji: 29-sai Dokushin wa Isekai de Jiyuu ni Ikita......katta.

108166.description: Itsumi loves drawing and wants to become a mangaka. She has zero interest in men but her friends says that if she wants to draw shoujo manga she definitely needs to learn how to drawn men. Itsumi reluctantly starts investigating the boys she knows...?

108169.description: A griffin medallion is the only lead to the "greatest" treasure on earth, and Miya has it. With bad guys everywhere trying to take the medallion away, will Miya be able to find the treasure?

108172.description:
Goblin Slayer Gaiden 2: Tsubanari no Daikatana is a spin-off series of the main Goblin Slayer! light novel. This is the second manga adaptation of the light novel.

Set 10 years prior to the original series, the story centers around Sword Maiden's party of six adventurers on their journey to the Dungeon of the Dead to kill the Demon Lord.
synonyms: Goblin Slayer Side Story 2: Daikatana of Singing Death

title.english: Goblin Slayer Side Story II: Dai Katana
title.native: ゴブリンスレイヤー外伝2 鍔鳴の太刀
title.romaji: Goblin Slayer Gaiden 2: Tsubanari no Daikatana

108175.description:
What is the difference between something that is quickly forgotten and something that cannot be forgotten? This is a story about memories and buildings of people living on a mysterious isolated desert island.

(Source: Kodansha)

108177.description: Nekoya Ai is a cute teenager who turns into a cat uncontrollably when he is under emotional distress. After being cornered by delinquents he gets help from a scary looking guy who turns out to be a real cat lover and his classmate to top it off. Will Ai be able to keep his shape-shifting​ condition a secret?

108178.description:
The official adaptation of the TYPE-MOON phenomenon that has become one of the most popular mobile games in the world! The year is 2016, and glitches found in humanity’s past threaten the sustainability of its future. The Chaldea Security Organization—tasked with preserving human history for as long and as strongly as possible—has developed a new method of time travel to repair these events, stabilizing humanity’s future. But when an unknown threat pushes mankind to the brink of extinction, young recruits Mash Kyrielight and Ritsuka Fujimaru find themselves at the helm of the rescue mission: Obtain the Holy Grail in a face off against fate itself …

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: This manga adapts the first, second, fourth, sixth and final singularity from Part 1 of Fate/Grand Order.

108179.description:
What is the terrifying secret behind beautiful honor student Yui Kamio's hair?! And why must she always keep it tied up? Super popular Kiito's high school life is plunged into chaos by the worst classmate imaginable! Hiroshi Shiibashi, the creator of Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan, delivers a comedy that isn't afraid to let loose!

(Source: Manga Plus)

title.romaji: Kamio Yui wa Kami wo Yui

108180.description: Riku and his young son Issei share an unbreakable bond. One day, they set foot on the distant island of Haruta, nestled in the Okinawa archipelago. There, Issei begins attending the local school, opening himself to new friendships and discoveries. For father and son, a new chapter unfolds — a chance to embrace a serene, unhurried life together.
synonyms: I've Come to Cut Your Hair

108182.description:
Collection of one-shots:

1-3) Dorobou Ring (泥棒リング)
4) Gozen Reiji no Love Letter (午前零時のラブレター)
5) DoroRin no Omake Manga (泥リンおまけマンガ)

108183.description:
After being made fun of for singing her favorite song, Toyama Kasumi, a first year high school student, could no longer directly express herself. Spending her melancholic days, she is led by fate to meet a guitar and new friends. Together, they will form bonds.

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

108184.description:
Toyama Kasumi, a first year high schooler with a shy personality, can no longer sing and express her emotions ever since she was made fun of her singing her favorite song. She is lonely and could not make friends even after entering high school. The only time she could show her emotions is through an exchange diary on her desk with a mysterious person named "Saaya" (サアヤ). Saaya seems to attend classes at a fixed time.

On one of her melancholic days, Kasumi saw star-shaped stickers pointing to a direction which she followed and end up at a pawnshop where she found a star-shaped guitar named "Random Star." Seeing the guitar, Kasumi wants to change herself and "shoot for her dreams".

Ichigaya Arisa, the girl she met at the pawnshop, offered Kasumi an alternative. Instead of buying the guitar, Kasumi will get the guitar in exchange of joining Arisa's game called "BanG_Dream!"

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

title.native: BanG Dream! 星の鼓動〈スタービート〉

108185.description:
Kasumi Toyama has always been captivated by the "beat of the stars." Since then, she's been searching for something... a spark that'll excite and thrill her! Following a trail of star-shaped stickers, she soon stumbles upon a Random Star guitar at her school mate's house! Could this mark the start of something amazing?

A sparkling, heart-racing high school life begins for Kasumi as she decides to form a band!

(Source: Shogakukan Asia)

108186.description: An estranged aunt names Jayne the inheritor of her estate. The only condition? Continue to employ the servants.

title.native: ジェイン・ウォーカー

108187.description: The "definitive" version of the Code Geass manga. Set when Lelouch and Suzaku begin the Zero Requiem Plan.

title.native: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ Re;
title.romaji: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch Re;

108188.description: Young, successful, ambitious. The young CEO was born to conquer. After his untimely death, he wakes up in an alternate world as the eldest daughter of Count Hall McGrewd. "I may be in a damsel's body, but you won't find me in any distress!" Follow the newly reborn Farrell Hall McGrewd as she begins to take over in the other world of nobles and magic.
synonyms: ザークル・ゼロの異世界勇者事業

108189.description:
With Japan’s aging population and low birthrate, it's now up to average office worker Hatoko to turn into magical girl Ruby to fight evil.

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.
synonyms: Hatoko Rarely Acts Like a Magic Girl
Hatoko is Sometimes a Magical Girl

title.native: 鳩子さんは時々魔法少女

108190.description:
The manga will center on a former delinquent starting a completely unfitting job.

(Source: Anime News Network)

108191.description: A narcissistic girl meets a boy with brainwashing powers.

108192.description:
In Niaru City, a town nestled in the mountains, mysterious creatures that look just like human heads have started to pop up.

The locals have grown fond of these beings, calling them "Newmons." One day, high schooler Aoi Tooi encounters a Newmon in the woods—right as he is attempting to commit suicide.

From the head to the boy, and the boy to the head. A fragile slice-of-life story about two (?) beings learning the meaning of life from one another.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

108193.description:
The series is inspired by Tezuka's The Vampires. The manga is set in modern Kyoto (as opposed to Tokyo in the earlier manga) and centers on aspiring manga creator Ako Kitayama. One day, while on a train station platform, she witnesses a battle between a "hunter" and another young man who can also transform. She decides to use the incident as story material for her manga. Ako submits the storyboard draft for the manga to her editor. But not only does he reject the manga, he says "He told me to bring you," delivering Ako to a young man who suddenly appears in the room. 108289.description:
The story begins in Vienna in 1907, as the city holds a lavish birthday celebration for its beloved Princess Flora. The princess entertains a variety of suitors from around the world who have come to propose marriage. Also on hand for the celebration is Phoenix, a handsome, gentlemanly jewel thief who has his eye on stealing the princess's precious gemstone, the "Smile of the Amazon." Upset with Phoenix's brash manner, Princess Flora drops the ring holding her gemstone into a cooked fish and throws it out the window, to the shock of everyone present.

Meanwhile, a young teenaged orphan named Honey Honey is working as a waitress. Her pet cat and constant companion, Lily, spies the fish that the princess threw out the window and proceeds to eat the entire fish, thus swallowing the ring. Since Princess Flora has declared that whichever of her suitors successfully returns the ring to her shall become her husband, the princess's suitors and Phoenix immediately fan out all over the city pursuing Lily and her owner, Honey Honey.

Phoenix catches up with Honey and Lily and helps them hide from the princess's suitors. Honey proceeds to tell the handsome jewel thief the story of how she was orphaned and brought up in a convent, and of how she befriended Lily, who, like her, was abandoned. Phoenix then tries to persuade Honey to sell Lily to him, but Honey, who is still unaware that Lily has swallowed the princess's ring, furiously refuses and immediately flees. Honey and Lily hide in the basket of a hot-air balloon, which soon lifts off with Phoenix and Princess Flora's suitors still in hot pursuit. Thus begins an adventure in which Honey and Lily are pursued by Phoenix, Princess Flora, and her suitors to various cities around the world, including Paris, New York City, Oslo, London, Monte Carlo and Gibraltar. Along the way, Honey falls in love with Phoenix and tries to keep Lily out of the clutches of the selfish, vain princess...

After waking up at his own funeral, Tenma Otori gets a second chance at life when a god from another world presents him with an enticing offer: if Tenma agrees to be reincarnated in order to save their dying world, the gods will bestow cheat abilities upon him. Tenma accepts, and is reborn in a lush fantasy world filled with demi-humans, magic spells and items, monsters, mysterious forests, and more! As he grows, more of his gods-given powers and abilities—including his unique power to befriend adorable monsters like slimes and baby wolves—are revealed to his adoptive parents, two former master adventurers, and his grandfather, a famous wizard. In a world where people have one of three genders—alpha, beta, or omega—in addition to being male or female, alphas have pushed their way to the top. Omegas are oppressed, their status determined by whether or not they successfully bear alpha children. An omega named Saimon marries into the prolific Hanabusa family, a major conglomerate, but is unable to produce an heir for his alpha husband Seijuro, and is shunned as a “Megaera,” a creature that brings ill fortune. One day, Saimon is summoned by the family patriarch Zenjiro and ordered to locate the man’s illegitimate son. Saimon finds the boy, Mamiya, who has been making a life for himself on the streets while hiding the fact that he’s an omega. Desperate to regain his position as Seijuro’s top spouse, Saimon proposes an audacious plan: pass Mamiya off as an alpha heir and try to gain the headship of the Hanabusa family.

The story follows a sullen middle-aged novelist named Masamune who adopts a beautiful second grader named Karen. Karen is wealthy and likes to dress up in lolita-style clothing. The story develops into "fake family romantic comedy."

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Contains 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: Daughter in Love Won't Call Me Papa
Koi suru Ojou-sama wa Papa to Yobitakunai

title.native: 恋するお嬢様はパパと呼びたくない
title.romaji: Koisuru Ojousama wa Papa to Yobitakunai

108656.description:
Asatsuki village, where the Inugami belief is deeply rooted, the people of the construction company who came to investigate the Inugami shrine died while the village opinions were divided over redevelopment. Tsukiko Tachibana and three childhood friends who live in the village are involved in the incident while participating in the festival to send Inugami ...⁉

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

108657.description:
New one shot by Hari Tokeino, first serialized in LaLa 2019/05 Issue.

Suzume Tanno, a girl who doesn't know love, and Aoi Kurasame, the nature boy, are playing the main roles of "Romeo and Juliette" for their class play, but...

108659.description:
Rumspringa... a period when some Amish youth experience greater freedom to decide whether to remain in their community as devout Christians or abandon their families and live in the outside world... In 1980s in America. Oz, who once dreamed of performing on Broadway, is now working as a waiter and male prostitute in a small town in the countryside. One day, he mistakenly takes Theo, a young man in his rumspringa period, into his room as a "customer" when he comes to the bar. Oz could not leave Theo who has nowhere to go alone, so he ends up taking care of Theo. As he comes close to Theo, who is pure and don't know how to be angry or suspicious of people even when they make fun of him for being Amish, Oz was moved by his kindness and realizes that he should not be obsessed with his failure in New York forever. He also begins to realize his feelings toward Theo and starts to love him and...

(Source: MediBang)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: ラムスプリンガの情景

108660.description:
Many glittering miniature gardens!! A kaleidoscope of fantastic fairy tales!! Boy, girl, old man, old man, old woman, god, demon, youkai... A miniature garden world woven by wonderful people.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

108661.description:
I was originally the son of the shrine official for the Year of the Tiger in the Immortal Realm. Since I underwent tribulations, I had to come down to the Mortal Realm to search for the one who can help me get through the immortal tribulations to advance in rank as an immortal.
Who knew that my power would be sealed and that I would turn into a kitten!
The one who can save me also turned out to be an extreme cat-lover, h-he pulled my tail, rubbed my belly, a-and even touched my balls!?
synonyms: Chú Mèo Thượng Tiên Của Ta

108662.description:
She was the Queen of Song, but she died during her greatest years. After she was reincarnated, she became a simple trainee. Did she lose her former glory? It doesn't matter—no one can compete with her beautiful singer's voice. She's mocked for her lowly birth? It doesn't matter—her true identity is enough to make the whole world tremble. Does she owe huge debts? It doesn't matter...

A powerful boss whispered to her: "The debt will disappear if you would become my woman." But she is proud: "I'm sorry. I would sell my art, but not my whole self."

This is the story of the Queen of Song, of her return to the peak... and an overbearing chairman.

(Source: WebNovel)

title.english: A Star Reborn: The Queen's Return

108663.description:
Jing Yiren was a proud and talented 14-year-old princess. One night, she was transmigrated, and she became the 19-year-old wife of Lu Conglomeration's President. This sudden change would test every fiber of her being!

For his part, Lu Ming now has to deal with a wife who is wholly confused by her new station in life. In the face of such problems, he can only get through to her with his actions.

(Source: WebNovel)

title.english: Sweetheart V5: The Boss Is Too Kind!
title.romaji: Tianxin V5: BOSS Chong Zhiguo Ji

108664.description: One-shot of a cute girl with snakes for hair.

title.native: メドゥーサさんみつめないで

108665.description: "Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru Punitto!" is a sequel to "Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha-bu Shozoku". It is humorous, slice-of-life spin-off that focuses on the daily lives of the Hero Club.
synonyms: Yuuki Yuuna is a Hero Club Member Squishy!

title.native: 結城友奈は勇者部所属 ぷにっと！
title.romaji: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru Punitto!

title.native: 爬虫類が脱皮してなんか人間っぽくなる漫画
title.romaji: Hachuurui ga Dappi Shite Nanka Ningen Poku naru Manga

synonyms: Isuzu Elf is the World's Strongest Truck

title.native: 異世界最強トラック召喚、いすゞ・エルフ
title.romaji: Isekai Saikyou Truck Shoukan, Isuzu Elf

108668.description: "EROS Survival" is a show broadcasted over the internet where pair of players - a male and a female - compete for the grand prize of $1m! To win though the pairs must demonstrate both knowledge and skills in order to 'strip' their opponents, progress through the rounds and grab that super prize!

108669.description:
In the near future, the nation once known as Japan has been divided and jointly ruled by China and Russia. Behind the scenes, China develops a top-secret bioweapon known as the “Wōrō” (War Wolf)—engineered to counter Russian forces. But when forty-nine experimental subjects escape and barricade themselves inside a demilitarized neutral zone between the two countries, the project spirals into chaos. As China attempts to erase all evidence and Russia moves in to capture and study them, the fugitive Wolves fight desperately for their survival.

With the agendas of three opposing forces colliding, a near-future sci-fi action epic roars into motion!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

108670.description:
A few generations ago, a mysterious phenomenon occurred. Humans now die after 1.5 billion heartbeats; half the heart rate they originally had. Schools began teaching students how to control their emotions and regularly performed heart rate tests. No one is allowed to use more than the number assigned per week.

The story of two girls who chose to love regardless of their finite heartbeats.

108671.description: Even though Makabe Masamune's lost a lot of weight, change his family name, and stood on the top of the caste as a super hunk, somehow happenings with “Re○○○” occur every morning he comes to school, confusing Aki and his other friends...

108672.description:
The human era has ended. This world is one where society has already collapsed.

While people have slowly accepted the fate of their race, someone has started their journey: a girl and a dog. This tale, while a little lonely, is also filled with warmth. A slow life at the end of the world.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 旅とごはんと終末世界
title.romaji: Tabi to Gohan to Shuumatsu Sekai

108673.description: An otaku living in his man cave, waiting for his limited edition figure that will help him something for academic purposes. Though what came in was a wounded dragon. He gave this dragon some bandage that came out of nowhere and some no brand potato chips. This potato chips somehow contained healing power that healed the dragon. The dragon started talking about itself and the otaku mc was really happy about the plot twist that's happening. The dragon decided to go to shower, became a loli, and I had an episode of nosebleed.

108674.description: Ataru, a young man who lost his life in an unfortunate case, receives three special powers from God and reincarnates into a different world. The strongest gun, the ability to create bullets freely, and the ability to see everything called "magic eyes". Atal, who is the only gunner in this world, casts himself into a supreme supple adventurer guild with the beastman girl Caro who is rescued from slavery and takes on Atal. The sniper's up-and-coming hero who eliminates any enemy with a single blow, opening from here.
synonyms: Break Through in Another World With Magical Eyes and Bullets!!

title.native: 魔眼と弾丸を使って異世界をぶち抜く!
title.romaji: Magan to Dangan wo Tsukatte Isekai wo Buchinuku!

108675.description:
Stuck in a world that is not his own, the God of this world gives Ataru three special powers - magic eyes that see through everything, a gun only he can wield, and the power to make magic bullets at will. With rescued slave companion Caro at his side, what kind of adventures can they find together?

(Source: Manga Planet)
synonyms: Break Through in Another World With Magical Eyes and Bullets!!

title.english: Shoot Through a Different World with Magical Eyes and Bullets!
title.native: 魔眼と弾丸を使って異世界をぶち抜く！
title.romaji: Magan to Dangan wo Tsukatte Isekai wo Buchinuku!

108676.description:
Jihyo is an Account Executive at a mid-size ad firm. Jegook is Jihyo's ex-boyfriend who shows up one day as a very important client. Jihyo tries to avoid working for Jegook, but the client is too important for her company that she has no way to escape.

What does he want from Jihyo?!

(Source: NETComics)

108677.description: Twitter comic about a girl who suspects her childhood friend to be a lesbian.
synonyms: I Suspect my Childhood Friend is a Lesbian
I Suspect My Childhood Friend to Be a Lesbian
愛情表現が過ぎる幼馴染

108678.description:
For his inheritance, he married her; for her family, she married him, how does one maintain a loveless marriage? The nightmare began on the first night of our marriage, he actually dared to bring another woman home! Does he think I’ll just accept this? Ling Qiao, you player, go and die!

(Source: Web Novel)

title.english: Overnight Riches: I married the Director
title.romaji: Yiye Haomen: Zongcai Wo Yi Hun

108679.description:
The stoic guy in the black suit is a dork who likes sweets? As a manager in a fancy cake cafe "Kuma Purin," I was told that liking manly things does not suit me. One day, this mysterious man with eyes like a killer came in front of my shop... It turned out he is a total opposite of myself!

(Source: Manga.Club)

title.english: I Want to Spoil Ikuro-san (43 y.o.)
title.native: 郁郎さん（43歳）は甘えたい

108680.description:
Xiu Xiaotao, an ordinary girl who is tone-deaf, swaps bodies with her idol, the super popular singer Ling Xi. After all kinds of chaos, accidents, and misunderstandings, she begins to crush various male idols, becomes a successful, multi-talented star, and starts on a trip to the very top of the entertainment world!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: I Swapped Bodies with My Idol!

108681.description:
One night in a luxurious villa, Fang Yi was humiliated by a man called Lin Han, who had countless ties with her. Their lives have been destined to entangle each other since the first time they met as children… After all these years, did Fang Yi manage to turn her life into a new place? What kind of romance and tension will be happening between them? What is the secret behind their hatred to each other?

(Source: Manga Toon)

108682.description:
Not only did I wake up in a coffin, I even became a 'man'! did I have a time travel? What’s with this man’s dress? The life in another world is not easy, and I even have to deal with that dark and cunning duke!

(Source: Manga Toon)
synonyms: Moi et le prince, tous les deux enlacés
ท่านอ๋องแหย่ไม่ได้

108683.description:
"You promised I could have you". That is what Misaki's former student Yuki says when she sees him after 4 years. Yuki has grown to a man and aggressively pursues her. Although Misaki is confused and hesitant in the beginning, she slowly gives in, and the relationship becomes sweet and sexy... "He takes my heart by force and melts it... I cannot deny his love."

(Source: Renta!)

108684.description:
Can you sexually liberate an immature ghost?! A ghost possesses a human in order to scare him, but finds his body being played with instead... Wait, what?! The ghost tries to frighten Minato, but Minato, able to see him, is completely indifferent to his attempts. In fact, he finds it amusing! When Minato decides to tease him in return for a little fun, he finds that this ghost reacts in the most adorable ways... Feeling his sadistic side take over, Minato decides to train his new ghost companion... What will happen?!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Training the Ghost Who Possessed My House
title.native: 幽霊が住みついたので調教してみた。
title.romaji: Yuurei ga Sumitsuita no de Choukyou Shite Mita.

108686.description:
Mai dreams of becoming a fluent English-speaker and teacher, because her first crush was an American boy. In the astronomy club her friends make her join. There's a boy named Saburo, who says he'll teach her. He looks cool and a little distant. ...But after the welcome party, Mai wakes up next to him... in his bed!! "You were so cute yesterday night", he says, with a satisfied smile on his face... "Wait, did we have sex!?"

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 初恋を教えてもらった

108687.description:
“No problem. A man always keeps his word. We can do it as many times as you want." Sakiko Kotohira is a devoted yaoi fangirl and absolutely head over heels for Reiji, the cool, dominant protagonist of her favorite comic. One of the highlights of Sakiko's day is catching a glimpse of Masayuki Utazu, a coworker who happens to look just like Reiji. One day, distracted by her daydreams, Sakiko suddenly finds herself face-to-face with the office lookalike. He turns out to be even hotter than she'd imagined. Desperate for material to fuel future fantasies, Sakiko all but rips her clothes off and pounces on the guy. Masayuki's cool, imperial resolve melts away in a second. Further prompted by a secret reason of his own, Masayuki decides he has to have her!! Get ready for a showdown between two explosive desires, as well as a passionate battle of misunderstandings!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Guy I'm into Is a You-Know-What!

108688.description:
Yuna, who longs for a sweet, steamy romance, has a dream about making intense love with a strange, beautiful boy. Her friend Mayuko then takes her to Rouge Garden, a cafe filled with handsome servers, one of whom looks exactly like the man in her dream! Who is this mysterious Tomoya, and what secrets are he and the other servers hiding...?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Pure Blood x Virgin Vampire Cafe

title.english: The Pure-Blood and the Maiden -Vampire Cafe-
title.native: 純血×処女 ヴァンパイアカフェ

108689.description:
Five years ago, in the middle of winter, Kosuke Kurono's beloved sister was raped and murdered. Ever since then, he has devoted his life to revenge. When he finally avenged his sister's death, Kurono had nothing left to live for, and he decided to end his own life, too. But instead, he was reincarnated into another world, and given the Black Magic wielded by the great heroes of the past. Being told that his sister might have reincarnated into this world, too, he set out to look for her!

(Source: Comic Ride, translated)
synonyms: Avenger's Second Lifetime Around In Another World

title.native: 復讐完遂者の人生二周目異世界譚 THE COMIC
title.romaji: Fukushuu Kansuisha no Jinsei Nishuume Isekaitan THE COMIC

108690.description: It started as any other day for the three sisters Tsumugi, Momo and Rin and their father. But they soon learn that everyone has disappeared and they appear to be the only humans left on earth. How will they survive?

title.native: ローカルワンダーランド
かかしがきいたかえるのはなし
title.romaji: Kakashi ga Kiita Kaeru no Hanashi

108693.description:
Kanna Tachibana is a 26-year-old woman who hasn't yet felt the stirrings of physical attraction...that is, until she meets her new charge, the "Prince of Piano" Guy Narisawa Weissenfeld. After listening to his playing, she finds herself unable to stop herself caressing him...?! Will she be able to explore her budding sensuality with a man who has been told he plays with no emotion? And not only that, can she step up to save this irascible performer's career while she's at it?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: 世にも不実なピアノソナタ
title.romaji: Yo ni mo Fujitsu na Piano Sonata

108695.description:
Serialization of the original doujinshi with the same title

Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title.romaji: Ore ga Watashi ni Naru made

108696.description:
In the spring of 1952, 11-year-old Chizuru moves with her family (her father, his new wife, and her new younger brother) to the town of Nochiu in Hokkaido, a place with strong Ainu roots. They plan to live in a spare building on the property of her father's close friend. That friend has a family of his own, which includes twins, Takeshi and Shizuko, who are Chizuru's age.

Ever since Chizuru survived the air raid in Tokyo that killed her mother and older brother, she has been unable to speak and her memories are confused. However, once they began their journey to Nochiu, she has had the same dream every night. She's in a forest, and someone is calling her name. When she meets Shizuko, she is surprised to realize that Shizuko is the one calling to her in her dreams. Why is Shizuko calling for her, and what are the secrets she seems meant to learn?

title.native: マンガでわかる 未来の年表
title.romaji: Manga de Wakaru: Mirai no Nenpyou

108698.description: An young man has to kill 100 friends in order to save his sister's life.

108699.description:
On that day, suddenly, every single male virgin over the age of 18 started dying rapidly, causing a huge panic across Japan! Sex industry prices skyrocket overnight, forming angry mobs of terrified virgins, and the government knows not how to handle such an unprecedented crisis.

Enter our protagonist, 17-year old virgin Kurumi Eiri. He has to get laid before his 18th birthday, or he'll die! He hurriedly confesses to girls, only to be shot down without any hope. Is there any way for him to graduate from virginity?! What will the virgins do when death is staring them in the face?!

108700.description:
A "delinquent" who freezes up and says violent things when around women meets a small girl in the library when he's out studying. To his surprise, she tutors him, even though an elementary student shouldn't be able to. As it turns out, she's a high school student and his classmate; she's eager to befriend him. Also surprising to him is the fact that he isn't afraid of her. Could it be because he sees her as a kid? Or does he?

Includes 2 bonus chapters.
synonyms: Tale of a Girl and a Delinquent Who's Bad with Women

title.native: 女が苦手なヤンキーと少女の話
title.romaji: Onna ga Nigate na Yankee to Shoujo no Hanashi

108701.description:
Alfred Rindt is the strongest wizard. After taking a cursed arrow to the knee, he just wants some peace and quiet to heal. But, being a famous hero has its downsides. Everyone in the royal capital is demanding his assistance! Alfred decides he needs to get away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, so he takes a job as a village guard in the countryside. Will Alfred finally get the rest he so desires, or will the countryside prove to be just as lively as the city he left behind?

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: I Used to Be the Strongest Sorcerer. Then I Took an Arrow in the Knee and Became a Village Guard
The Strongest Wizard Becomes a Countryside Guardsman After Taking an Arrow to the Knee
นักเวทสุดแกร่ง ถูกธนูปักเข่าเลยมาเป็นทหารยามประจำหมู่บ้าน
最強的魔導士，膝蓋中了一箭之後成為鄉下的衛兵

title.english: The Strongest Wizard Becomes a Countryside Guard After Taking an Arrow to the Knee
title.native: 最強の魔導士。ひざに矢をうけてしまったので田舎の衛兵になる
title.romaji: Saikyou no Madoushi. Hiza ni Ya wo Ukete Shimatta no de Inaka no Eihei ni Naru

108703.description:
Reo and Mabu, supernatural cops and agents of a certain empire, are surprised to find a baby lying on a plate in the street! They take her in as they search for her parents, but their bizarre lives keep leading them in wild directions. Strangely, this baby–whom they name Sara–seems to have supernatural powers as well…and these two men are starting to love her as if she were their own.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Appearing in director Kunihiko Ikuhara's new anime Sarazanmai (starts April 11, 2019), Reo and Mabu's soft daily life is portrayed in this BL spinoff manga!
synonyms: Leo to Mabu: Futari no Sarazanmai
Reo and Mabu: Together They're Sarazanmai

title.native: レオとマブ ～ふたりはさらざんまい～
title.romaji: Reo to Mabu: Futari no Sarazanmai
Yuubin Haitatsu to Yoru no Kuni

108705.description: Harlock goes to Sengoku era in Japan and meets Masamune Date.
synonyms: Dokuganryu Masamune: Sengoku no Arcadia Gaiden

title.native: 髑眼竜政宗～戦国のアルカディア外伝～
title.romaji: Dokuganryuu Masamune: Sengoku no Arcadia Gaiden

108706.description: Jump into the life of twenty-something Naru as he navigates through the confusing world of modern dating. He’s faced with familiar moments we’ve all been through such as “should I add that smiley face at the end of the text?” or “why haven’t they responded to my text?” But the added challenge for Naru? He’s never dated, doesn’t use a cellphone and most importantly someone’s out there to sabotage his dating life!
synonyms: พรุ่งนี้ต้องทำงานอีกแล้วเรอะ!

108707.description:
Struggling to move on from a two-year relationship, a heartbroken Miku acts on impulse and hits on a handsome stranger named Hikaru. He agrees with surprising ease, and they impulsively head to a hotel! Althoug panic sets in as Miku manages to escape before things go too far. Later, she has a surprise run-in with him at a café bar where he’s working! His enigmatic and unreadable demeanor makes her feel like she is drifting into a dangerously complicated dynamic... Or is it?!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

108708.description: The story is centered around a high school full of delinquents consisting of an elite class with famous warlords from the Warring States period in Japan.
synonyms: Shin Shinchō Kōki: Nobunaga-kun to Watashi
The New Official History of Nobunaga - Nobunaga and Me

title.native: 新・信長公記 〜ノブナガくんと私〜
title.romaji: Shin Shinchou Kouki: Nobunaga-kun to Watashi
Ore ga Watashi ni Naru made

108710.description: University student Ichika Sogawa suddenly inherits five-trillion yen from her father, and attempts are made on her life by her siblings. Her avaricious family made a deal amongst themselves, to let the person who kills Ichika first take all the money, and they try all sorts of means to take her life. To protect Ichika, her housekeeper hires the investigator Hikaru Chikumagawa, who has a perfect record of solving cases before they happen.

108711.description: Once every hundred years, a phenomenon occurs in which a single man is given a "god sword" by the valkyrie. Seven years ago, one man received this power and ushered in a revolution in the northernmost country of Lorecia. Lorencia's prince, Nikolai, who lost everything in the revolution, encounters a new valkyrie. And thus fate begins to turn.

108716.description: Student Natsume has always remained true to his principle in love: travelers should not be stopped. He has never run after an ex. Until suddenly someone runs after him: The beautiful tea ceremony master Rio ...

108718.description: Daidai Machi, situated near a major grain-producing​ region, nestled up against a gigantic tree, is the place where the people live out their lives. Seri has moved to this town that opens into the distant beyond, blossoming with an alien culture. I invite you to join in on Seri's daily life, which she lives by the motto of "I won't work hard.

108720.description:
Hikage Nemoto, a young, shy and mousey part-time teacher finds herself unwittingly awakening some rather... fundamental feelings from all the women she meets... Will she prevail?

Included chapters: 26.1

108721.description:
"Please! Do it for your family. You have to marry him!" To save her family's traditional Japanese confectionery shop, Yuki agrees to go on a date with the heir to a big enterprise. Yuki's never had a boyfriend, but she decides that helping her family is more important. At first, she's nervous to meet this man who's eight years older than her, but once they start talking, things go pretty well. That is, until his attitude suddenly changes and he drags her into a hotel room... "What do you think you're doing!?" "If we're getting married, we should make sure we've got good chemistry." What's going to... happen...?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Omae o Ore no Suki ni Suru

title.english: I'm Going to Have My Way with You
title.native: お前を俺の好きにする～ドS系御曹司とカラダ契約
title.romaji: Omae wo Ore no Suki ni Suru: Do-S Kei Onzetsu to Karada Keiyaku

108722.description:
They were childhood friends, and she had always been more powerful than him. But when they accidentally traveled (summoned?) to another world, it was finally time for him to become the knight in shining armor! He had to find her first though, since they were separated... Come and witness his fight to be better in a crazy world where monsters roamed and technology was so advanced your amputated limbs be restored to perfection...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

108723.description:
Healer Carol is an E-rank... even among adventurers, it's the absolute weakest.

Even though I was told that I’d be useless... I tried my best for my comrades and continued creating medicines but… in the end, I was still thrown out of the party! I don’t have enough money to get back home and the future looks bleak in this strange town.

In the meantime, Carol met a dying adventurer, Kaido, by chance. She treated him with the medicine which she had created for free. While doing that, for some reason, the medicine received extremely high praise---!?

108724.description:
Tasaki is caught peeking by a group of gals who use the evidence to blackmail him into becoming their slave. One day Tasaki manages to hypnotize his masters. And so his revenge begins.
(Source: fourberie)
